fit.requirement: experience in TypeScript and React, comfortable with real-time sync

whyRole.text: Acme builds tools for event organisers, and that is a problem I already work on: I built Slash to run pub darts tournaments from phones.

whyMe.text: Slash has run 4 real pub tournaments, with live sync across three phones per match. synchd keeps a band on the same bar with a three-layer clock.

howIWork.text: I design the system and let AI coding agents write much of the code. Tests and my own tool, kiln, check every change before it ships.
